<user_query>
Explore the codebase at "g:\1.2.CMS-MAIN-ALL -ctt\quận 12 - Copy" for HTML export patterns related to bảng điểm / SubjectMark.

Find and return:
1. Full contents or key structure of existing MauHTML templates related to BangDiem (especially A3, HocKy, LanCuoi, QC09, ToanKhoa). List all files under **/MauHTML/**
2. From StudentManager/Leaning/frmSubjectMarkDetailOfCourse.cs - the NEW style ExportToHTML / DetailToHTML / how it picks MauHTML template (around lines that mention MauHTML, {DETAIL}, {HEADER_TEXT}). Return the full ExportToHTML and DetailToHTML methods if they exist in the non-quang-trung StudentManager version.
3. Check quang-trung/StudentManager for any MauHTML folder or SubjectMarkDetail.htm
4. Check .csproj for how MauHTML files are registered (Content + CopyToOutputDirectory)
5. Look at the repx sample: "quang-trung/mẫu chuyển dổi/các mẫu của nút- Bảng điểm tổng kết A3/Leaning_BangDiem_HocKy_LanCuoi_5QC09A3.repx" - extract labels/parameter names visible in the report (header fields, columns like TT, Mã số, Họ, Tên, subjects, statistics, footer signature). The file may be XML - search for labels, Report_Header, pXuatSac, etc.
6. Designer menu items for Export HTML in OfCourse forms

Return concrete file paths, method signatures, placeholder names used, and a summary of how Detail table is built for A3-style reports.
</user_query>
I'll explore the codebase for BangDiem/SubjectMark HTML export patterns, templates, and related report structures.
